title: The 12 basics
summary: Before you get lost in the glossary: 12 foundational AI words explained with concrete analogies for non-dev founders. A 3-minute read.

title: Bolt.new
summary: Bolt.new is StackBlitz's tool that builds a real web app from a plain description, no code needed. Perfect for prototyping an idea in a few minutes.

title: ChatGPT Atlas / Operator
summary: ChatGPT Atlas / Operator is OpenAI's agent browser: it browses, clicks, and buys for you. Reserved for Pro and Business subscribers. My honest take inside.

title: Choosing your model in 2026
summary: Not a catalog, a decision tree. 6 steps to pick THE right AI model in 2026 based on your use case, your budget and your data constraints. Built for non-dev founders.

title: Claude Haiku 4.5
summary: Claude Haiku 4.5: Anthropic's small, fast, cheap model, perfect for classifying, extracting, and automating at high volume without blowing your budget.

title: Claude Opus 4.7
summary: Claude Opus 4.7 is Anthropic's most powerful model in 2026: complex code, long reasoning, autonomous agents. Pricier than Sonnet, but a game-changer.

title: Claude Sonnet 4.6
summary: Claude Sonnet 4.6 is Anthropic's balanced model in 2026: fast, precise, sensibly priced. The default pick for 90% of what you do. My honest take.

title: Cursor
summary: Cursor is the AI-powered code editor devs live in in 2026, a direct rival to Claude Code. Not for non-devs, but worth knowing. Pricing, comparison, my take.

title: DeepSeek R1
summary: DeepSeek R1: the open-weight reasoning model from January 2025 that rattled OpenAI. Free weights, MIT license, the founding shock of open source.

title: DeepSeek V3.2
summary: DeepSeek V3.2 is the Chinese open-weight model with performance close to GPT-5, at 30x less on the API. The go-to when budget matters and you need scale.

title: ElevenLabs v3
summary: ElevenLabs v3 is the most natural AI voice engine in 2026: controllable emotions, multilingual, and voice cloning from just 30 seconds of audio.

title: Flux
summary: Flux is Black Forest Labs' family of image models: photorealistic, faithful to your prompt, with an open version. Pro, Dev, Kontext editions. Pricing and my take.

title: Gemini 2.5 Flash
summary: Gemini 2.5 Flash is Google's lightweight model: fast, 1M-token context, unbeatable price for crunching volume without blowing your budget.

title: Gemini 3.1 Pro
summary: Gemini 3.1 Pro is Google's model with a one-million-token context window, natively multimodal. Built to chew through huge volumes of data.

title: Genspark
summary: Genspark: the all-in-one AI agent platform. Deep research, slides, docs, and an agent that makes phone calls for you. Starts at $20/month.

title: GPT-5.5
summary: GPT-5.5 is OpenAI's premium model in 2026, the one behind ChatGPT: faster than GPT-5, a 270k-token context, and strong at math and reasoning.

title: GPT-5
summary: GPT-5 is OpenAI's big model from mid-2025, now replaced by GPT-5.5. Still on the API, no longer the default in ChatGPT. Comparison and my honest take.

title: Grok 4
summary: Grok 4 is xAI's AI built into X, with real-time access to posts. The handy tool for keeping up with the news of the moment, in a more direct tone.

title: Imagen 4
summary: Imagen 4 is Google DeepMind's image generator: three variants, very low pricing, built into Gemini and Google Workspace.

title: Kling
summary: Kling is Kuaishou's video generator (China): really strong on human motion, and 3 to 4 times cheaper than Sora 2 or Veo 3. Perfect for testing at volume.

title: Llama 4
summary: Llama 4 is Meta's open-weight model: free to download, host it yourself, 10M-token context. The most open one, not the smartest one.

title: Midjourney v7
summary: Midjourney v7: the image model with the best-looking output out of the box. Three words are enough to get four gorgeous visuals. Style References, draft mode, web and Discord.

title: Mistral Large 3
summary: Mistral Large 3 is Mistral AI's French model, released under Apache 2.0 so it's genuinely open-source. The European sovereignty pick, and great in French.

title: Nano Banana
summary: Nano Banana is Google's image model (Gemini 2.5 Flash Image): it generates and, above all, edits your photos in plain language, no Photoshop needed.

title: Perplexity Comet
summary: Perplexity Comet is Perplexity's web browser with a built-in AI agent: it browses, fills out forms, and compares for you. Pricing, Atlas comparison, my take.

title: Qwen 3
summary: Qwen 3 is Alibaba's open-weight model in 2026: 118 languages, an open license, and strong on niche languages. The other Chinese alternative to DeepSeek.

title: Replit Agent
summary: Replit Agent is the AI agent that builds and deploys a real web app straight from your browser, no coding. Perfect for testing a business idea. Pricing and my take.

title: Sora 2
summary: Sora 2 is OpenAI's video generator: a line of text becomes a 10-to-20-second clip with sound. The easiest way to get started with AI video.

title: Suno
summary: Suno: the mainstream AI song generator. Describe a style, hand it lyrics or not, and it spits out a full song with vocals in a few minutes.

title: Udio
summary: Udio is the AI song generator from ex-Google DeepMind folks. Often more believable than Suno on vocals and mixing, with section-by-section editing.

title: Veo 3
summary: Veo 3, Google DeepMind's video model: a realistic clip with native sound from a text prompt or an image. Unbeatable on cinematic scenes and landscapes.

title: Windsurf
summary: Windsurf is Codeium's AI-powered IDE, now owned by OpenAI. For devs: chat, autocomplete, and the Cascade agent. A direct rival to Cursor.
